name: Higashiyamato (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Higashiyamato city emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised letter W, like a crown.
history: Municipal flag of Higashiyamato, a city in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1963.

features.role: Higashiyamato city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised letter W, like a crown
